name: Wood Sorrel

facts.how: Raw as a trail nibble or salad lemon-note
facts.when: Spring into summer, fading in high heat

caution: The lemon tang is oxalic acid: fine as a garnish and nibble, unwise as a whole salad bowl, and worth skipping if you have kidney stone history.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: Three perfect hearts to a leaf, folding along their midline in strong sun, with small five-petal yellow flowers. Clover has ovals; sorrel has hearts.

sections.title: On the trail
sections.body: This is the classic first forage: safe to recognize, bright to taste, growing in every yard. The little pickle-shaped pods pop pleasantly.
